title: Sync upstream RapidRAW 07361a0a: Immich copy-to-folder; Immich edit sync no longer overwrites a concurrent local edit
source: CyberTimon/RapidRAW main at 07361a0aed11154459931020a083109f768ae5ff (normal merge; RapidRoom conflict resolution with Claude)
notes: Immich images are downloaded and then copied, not moved, into local folders; RapidRoom keeps its per-file transfer summary and card guard for copies. Also an Immich placeholder tooltip and upstream's red mask overlay fix. Fixes RapidRoom #422: the Immich edit sync now checks for local changes and writes the remote edit under one sidecar lock, so a local save made in between is kept and the remote edit becomes a conflict copy.
